ai_tool.caption: AI Tool
ai_tool.description: The AI capability - tool, resource, or prompt - invoked in the operation described by the event.

cache_scope.caption: Cache Scope
cache_scope.description: The cache scope, normalized to the caption of the cache_scope_id value. In the case of 'Other', it is defined by the event source. See specific usage.

cache_scope_id.caption: Cache Scope ID
cache_scope_id.description: The normalized identifier of the declared cache scope, determining whether shared intermediaries may cache a result. See specific usage.

99.caption: Other
99.description: The cache scope is not mapped. See the cache_scope attribute, which contains a data source specific value.

cache_ttl.caption: Cache TTL
cache_ttl.description: The declared freshness window of a cacheable result, in milliseconds.

input_schema_fingerprint.caption: Input Schema Fingerprint
input_schema_fingerprint.description: The fingerprint identifying the declared input contract (schema) of a capability, by reference rather than by value.

is_destructive.caption: Destructive
is_destructive.description: Indicates that an operation or capability may perform destructive updates. See specific usage.

is_idempotent.caption: Idempotent
is_idempotent.description: Indicates that repeated invocations with the same arguments have no additional effect. See specific usage.

is_open_world.caption: Open World
is_open_world.description: Indicates interaction with an open world of external entities rather than a closed domain. See specific usage.

output_schema_fingerprint.caption: Output Schema Fingerprint
output_schema_fingerprint.description: The fingerprint identifying the declared output contract (schema) of a capability, by reference rather than by value.

task_uid.caption: Task UID
task_uid.description: The unique identifier of a long-running task, correlating an originating call with subsequent task lifecycle events.

transport.caption: Transport
transport.description: The transport, normalized to the caption of the transport_id value. In the case of 'Other', it is defined by the event source. See specific usage.

transport_id.caption: Transport ID
transport_id.description: The normalized identifier of the transport binding used to reach a serving system. See specific usage.

99.caption: Other
99.description: The transport is not mapped. See the transport attribute, which contains a data source specific value.
